purpose: Close the gap between F4 reference/converter proof and real original-RV1126 runtime behavior without treating host, simulator, QEMU, or converter timing as silicon timing.

runtime_gate.reason: Original RV1126 is an RKNPU1 target; this gate exists specifically to require a real target runtime.

input_semantics.decoder_output: 3-channel residual in raw pixel-value units; reconstructed RGB = clamp(linear(left,right,phase_byte/255) + residual, 0, 255)

quality_gate.ground_truth: real native-60 intermediate frames; same F4 evaluation class
required_for_f5a_pass: every reconstructed output frame comes from the real RV1126 runtime
180 output positions verified for each tested rate
on-device reconstruction PSNR exceeds simple linear PSNR at 5, 10 and 15 fps
on-device reconstruction SSIM exceeds simple linear SSIM at 5, 10 and 15 fps
runtime-minus-F4-float deltas are reported but not hidden behind a converter-success claim

timing_gate.rknn_eval_perf: capture verbatim when available; only call it device-reported performance if the runtime confirms a real target
timing_gate.f5b_model_only_silicon_acceptance: requires repeated real-device timing from Rockchip device-reported perf or an on-board RKNPU1 C API harness, with warmup and p50/p95/p99
timing_gate.full_pipeline_1080p60_acceptance: NOT implied by model-only timing; external resize/warp/codec/queue/fabric costs remain separate

required_machine_record_fields: per-rate delta vs linear and F4 float
host-connected inference-call p50/p95/p99 with diagnostic-only label
